title: Madina Aayi Hai Zainab Magar Hussain Nahi
body:
Madine aayi hain Zainab magar Hussain nahi
Rabab saat hain bano bhi umme laila bhi, aur unke saat hai kulssom umme farwa bhi, libaas bewa ka pehne hue hain kubra bhi, wo koun bibi hai jiske laboon pa bain nahi, madine aayi hain Zainab magar Hussain nahi
Khushi kisi ko nahi hai watan mein aane ki, khushi ho kaise ke karbal mein kayenat looti, kahi suhaag loota aur kisi ki godh ujdi, ke ek lamha kisi ke bhi dil ko chain nahi, madine aayi hain Zainab magar Hussain nahi
Ali ka noore nazar Fatima ki jaan nahi, nabi ke pouze pa pehli si aan baan nahi, watan udaas bohat hain watanki shaan nahi, ye har faraf hai sada shahe mashraqain nahi, madine aayi hain Zainab magar Hussain nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo sard aah ke jo arsh ko hilate hai, wo teergi hai ke aankhou main chayi jati hai, na jaag pati hai laila na neendh aati hai, ye haal kyon na wo jab uska noore aain nahi, madine aayi hain Zainab magar Hussain nahi
Na poora qafela aaya na qafela salaar, aalam toh aaya hai lekin nahi aalam baradar, bache hain mardou mein bas ek Abid-e-bimaar, aur unke hotho pa shukre khuda hai bain nahi, madine aayi hain Zainab magar Hussain nahi
Jo shahazaadi aathara bhaiyo ki bahen, ussi pa qatm hue har tarah ke ranj o mehan, ussi ke shaano bandhi thi zalimo ne rasan, tadapti rehti hain pal bhar usko chain nahi, madine aayi hain Zainab magar Hussain nahi
Bhulaye kaise manazer wo saare mehshar ke, nazar mein chehre hain Akbar ke aur Asghar ke, shikista qalb hain aur daag hain bahattar ke, pukare kisko ab shahe masraqain nahi, madine aayi hain Zainab magar Hussain nahi ...
